Folder ingest now runs in the background. Start **Brokkr Forge Process**, then leave the app \u2014 Forseti keeps sorting on your device. When it finishes you get a notification: *Brokkr Forge complete, head back to forseti to finalize your case.* Open Case Profile and review **99_Inbox** items.

Forseti reads folder paths and filenames, samples multiple PDF pages with on-device OCR, and runs late-binding classification. **DOCX** files are text-extracted too.

• **85%–100%** — auto-filed
• **70%–84%** — **99_Inbox** + **File Here**
• **Below 70%** — manual sort in Inbox

Every bulk ingest writes **INGEST_AUDIT_latest.txt** at the case root. It lists confidence, routing, and alternate guesses. You can always move a file manually or use **File Here** to correct a suggestion. Nothing is sent to the cloud.

**Duplicate detection** skips files already in your workspace or picked twice in one batch. **Delete all** clears **99_Inbox** for a fresh triage. Every bulk ingest writes **INGEST_AUDIT_latest.txt** at the case root with confidence, routing, and alternate folder guesses — move or rename anything afterward.

Ingest is slow because Forseti samples multiple PDF pages with on-device OCR and runs late-binding classification. Expect roughly **15\u201330 minutes** for ~300 well-named files; **1,300+** files can take hours \u2014 batch by subfolder. Use **Brokkr Forge Process** via SAF, not adb push.

Target **SDK 35** (Google Play requirement), min SDK 26. Notifications are requested when you use deadlines or Brokkr Forge. Sorting uses a short **data-sync** foreground task while running. No advertising ID. Case files stay on your device until you tap Share. Same trial and unlock as production.
